channel.title: Installation :: Unreal Metadata Editor Tags Documentation
channel.description: Where to get it You can get Metadata Tags Editor on Fab. Installation from Fab Up-to-date general guide for Working with plugins in Unreal Engine. Plugin location If by any reason, you are installing the plugin manually, unpack it to {PROJECT_DIRECTORY/Plugins}You can also unpack it to you main Unreal installation which is located under C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_[version]\Engine\Plugins on Windows /Users/Shared/Epic Games/UE_[version]/Engine/Plugins on macOS Enabling the plugin Navigate to editor top bar and open Edit -> Plugins.
